public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Allow calibration with a one-line title clamp**

When the CSS supplied through the new `--css` option clamps chart titles to one line (for example, with `white-space: nowrap` or `-webkit-line-clamp: 1`), the `frame` and `long_title` headers have the same height. The existing `extra_lines < 1` guard in `profile_from()` then raises `RuntimeError` before this new clamp measurement is reached, so calibration cannot produce a profile for that theme even though `FrameMeasures.title_max_lines` supports 1. Allow zero growth when measuring a one-line clamp and add a calibration regression test for that case.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
